calculate_nDCG: calculate the normalized discounted cumulative gain between a similarity matrix and relevancy matrix for ranking evaluation
calculate_DCG: calculate the discounted cumulative gain for each query using a similarity matrix, relevancy matrix, and k counts mask
calculate_IDCG: calculate the ideal discounted cumulative gain for perfect retrieval using a relevancy matrix and k counts mask
calculate_k_counts: calculate the k counts mask from a relevancy matrix to determine the number of relevant items per query
run_nDCG_evaluation: run the nDCG module self-test to verify DCG, IDCG, and nDCG calculations against expected values
